target.summary: A target component is a proposal, not a guarantee; the engine does not write code. The relation (retain/modify/introduce/retire) is the engine's best read of the gap; a human reviewer may move a component from modify to retire or vice versa. A target component's contracts are derived from the source it descends from; new components have empty contracts until the engagement writes them.
